# lettermint_webhooks (Data Source)

List route-scoped Lettermint webhooks.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "lettermint_webhooks" "route" {
  route_id = "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000"
  enabled  = true
  sort     = ["name"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `route_id` (String)

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `event` (String)
- `search` (String)
- `sort` (List of String) Sort values in API order. The API default is -created_at.

### Read-Only

- `webhooks` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--webhooks))
